'''Draynor Village''', often shortened to '''Draynor''', is a small village located between [[Falador]] and [[Lumbridge]]. The village is featured in many quests, and is a popular training location due to its [[Willow tree|willow trees]] and [[master farmer]]s. 

== Transportation ==
Several teleports bring players into or close to Draynor Village, listed here with their teleport destination. From closest to farthest:

* {{Plink|Amulet of glory|pic=Amulet of glory(4)}} — directly to the village centre.
* {{Plink|Achievement diary cape}} — just south of the village bank.
* {{Plink|Spirit trees|pic=Spirit tree (Construction) icon}} — the [[spirit tree patch]] in [[Port Sarim]], west of the village.
* {{Plink|Explorer's ring 2}} can teleport players to the [[South Falador Farm|farm south of Falador]], north-west of Draynor.
* {{Plink|Draynor Manor Teleport}} — [[Draynor Manor]], just north of the village.
* {{plink|Minigame teleport|pic=Minigame icon}} — Port Sarim [[Rat Pits]], well west of the village. Usable once every 20 minutes.
* {{Plink|Necklace of passage}} — [[Wizards' Tower]], found south-east of the village.
* {{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon}} {{Fairycode|DIS}} — just south of the [[Wizards' Tower]].

==History==
Draynor Village traces its earliest origins to the arrival of [[Count Draynor]], a [[vampyre]] of [[House Drakan]] who was exiled from [[Morytania]] by his brother [[Lowerniel Drakan|Lord Lowerniel Drakan]]. Forced across the [[River Salve]], Count Draynor was greatly weakened by the crossing.{{CitePostbag |issue=19 |letter=Letter 4 |author=Solomon Lamescus}} He drifted westward with his servant [[Ruantun]] until he reached the quiet stretch of land that would eventually bear his name. It is unlikely that the village existed at the time of his arrival, given that the village was named after him.{{CiteNPC|npc=Morgan|quote=Count Draynor has cast a shadow over Draynor Village for generations. They even named the place after him for Saradomin's sake!|loc=Vampyre Slayer}}

Count Draynor eventually stopped terrorizing the village, having not been seen in generations,{{CiteNPC|npc=Morgan|quote= Well... it is true that some claim Count Draynor hasn't left his manor for generations now.|loc=Vampyre Slayer|notes=|name=}} as he has become too weak to leave the manor.{{CiteNPC|npc=Dr Harlow|quote=Who knowsh. Most likely he's grown too weak to do ssho.|loc=Vampyre Slayer|notes=|name=}} Some adventurers attempted to kill him, but none had returned.{{CiteNPC|npc=Dr Harlow|quote=Even a weak vampyre ish very dangerous. Just go ashk those other adventurers thatsh never came back.|loc=Vampyre Slayer|notes=|name=}} In the year 169, an [[Player character|adventurer]] successfully slew the Count by driving a [[stake]] through his heart.

==Locations==
===Marketplace===
There are several shops in the marketplace:

* [[Diango's Toy Store]], a place where players can buy [[fun weapons]] and retrieve non-[[tradeable]] [[holiday item]]s.
* [[Draynor Seed Market]], a stall ran by [[Olivia]]. Most [[hops seed|hops]] and [[Allotment patch/Seeds|vegetable seeds]] can be bought from her, and all can be stolen from the stall.
* [[Forestry Shop]], a shop ran by the [[Friendly Forester]] that exchange [[Forestry]] currency for unique rewards.
* [[Wine Shop.|Wine Shop]], a stall run by [[Fortunato]] which stocks [[bottle of wine|bottles]] and [[jugs of wine]], as well as [[jugs of vinegar]].

===Skill training spots===
In addition to training combat by fighting the various monsters in the village, there are spots in Draynor for players to train [[Fishing]], [[Woodcutting]], [[Firemaking]], [[Agility]], and [[Thieving]]:

* Five [[willow tree]]s grow in close proximity of each other just south-west of the bank, making it a popular Woodcutting location for [[free-to-play]] players. The large open space east of the trees also makes it popular for training Firemaking. Be warned that in-between the trees are two [[aggressive]] level 7 [[dark wizard]]s, who will attack any players under [[combat level]] 15. It is therefore not advised to train Woodcutting here with a lower combat.
* On the shore next to the trees are several [[small fishing net|net]] and [[fishing bait|bait]] [[fishing spot]]s, which can be used to catch either [[shrimps]], [[anchovies]], [[sardine|sardines]], and [[herring]].
* The marketplace features two thievable [[seed stall]]s and one thievable [[wine stall]]. These stalls are guarded by a pair of [[Market Guard (Draynor)|market guards]], who attack players who attempt to steal, or players who talk to any stall owners just after thieving from their stalls. In order to maximise the amount of stalls that can be thieved per hour, it is recommended to trap the two market guards in the [[Wise Old Man]]'s house. This can be done by attacking them, then walking into the Old Man's house and closing the door with the guards still inside. Players can walk up the stairs in order to remove aggression from the market guards afterwards. Using this method, players can expect much higher experience rates per hour.
* The [[Draynor Village Rooftop Course]] runs all the way around the village, starting at the furthest north-east house and ending at [[Ned]]'s house. The course requires level 1 Agility to access.
[[File:Draynor Bank Robbery.png|thumb|The [[Draynor bank]], robbed by the [[Wise Old Man]].]]

===Other===
Off the coast is [[Draynor island]], a small island that's only accessible by fairy ring with code {{Fairycode|CLP}}. The island is visited for a [[Treasure Trails/Guide/Coordinates/Hard#Hard%20Coordinates|hard coordinate clue]]. Additionally, the [[Draynor farm]], a small farm just east of the Agility course house, is close by.

== Inhabitants ==

=== Personalities ===

* {{Chatl|Aggie|txt=Aggie the Witch}}, a friendly witch who will sell players [[dyes]].
* Three{{Chatl|Banker|pic=Banker (male) chathead|txt=bankers}}, tellers that help players access the [[Bank of Gielinor]].
* {{Chatl|Diango}}, a spirited merchant who sells [[Toy|toys]], [[fun weapons]], and [[holiday items]].
* {{Chatl|Tree (Draynor guard)|txt=Draynor guard}}, a hidden guard investigating the [[Draynor bank robbery]].
* {{Chatl|Farmer|pic=Farmer's strawhat (male) chathead}}, a busy farmer who cannot be spoken to.
* {{Chatl|Fortunato}}, a [[wine]] merchant who buys and sells various wine-related items.
* {{Chatl|Friendly Forester}}, a forester who will sell items to players through the [[Forestry Shop]].
* {{Chatl|Joe (jail)|txt=Joe}}, a bodyguard for Lady Keli with an exploitable drinking problem.
* {{Chatl|Lady Keli}}, a vain bandit that holds a captive [[Prince Ali]] in the village jail.
* {{Chatl|Leela}}, a spy from Al Kharid who helps the player free [[Prince Ali]].
* {{Chatl|Martin the Master Gardener}}, a master gardener who will sell players the [[Farming cape]] after they reach level 99 in the skill.
* {{Chatl|Miss Schism}}, the town gossip who sits outside the Wise Old Man's house and watches the [[bank]].
* {{Chatl|Maris}}, the wife of [[Morgan]].
* {{Chatl|Morgan}}, a village resident who's afraid of the looming threat of [[Count Draynor]].
* {{Chatl|Ned}}, a retired sailor who sells rope and plays a role in several quests.
* {{Chatl|Olivia}}, a seed merchant who stocks all vegetable and hops seeds, but only sells some of them to players.
* {{Chatl|Shady stranger}}s, spies of [[Lucien]] sent to watch [[Movario]] but followed a false trail to Draynor.
* {{Chatl|Spria}}, a low-level [[Slayer master]] who assigns the same tasks as [[Turael]], but doesn't allow tasks to be skipped.
* {{Chatl|Suspicious outsider}}s, spies of [[Lucien]] sent to watch [[Movario]] but followed a false trail to Draynor.
* {{Chatl|Ruantun}}, a weak [[vampyre]] that helps players craft [[Silver pot|silver pots]].
* {{Chatl|Town crier|pic=Town Crier (Draynor Village) chathead}}, a man who announces information about the latest game updates.
* {{Chatl|Twiggy O'Korn}}, a master of [[Achievement Diaries]] who will sell players the [[Achievement diary cape|diary cape]] after they complete all tasks.
* {{Chatl|Wise Old Man}}, a retired wizard who will sell players the [[Quest point cape|quest cape]] after they complete all quests.

==Quests==
Many [[quests]] either start in or require players to visit Draynor Village:

* [[A Porcine of Interest]] — Started by looking at a noticeboard in the Draynor marketplace.
* [[Desert Treasure I]] — [[Ruantun]] in the [[Draynor Sewers]] will help craft a [[silver pot]].
* [[Dragon Slayer I]] — [[Ned]] captains the [[Lady Lumbridge|ship]] to [[Crandor]].
* [[Fairytale I - Growing Pains|Fairytale I]] & [[Fairytale II - Cure a Queen|II]] — Started by speaking to [[Martin the Master Gardener]].
* [[Land of the Goblins]] — [[Aggie]] helps make [[Black dye|black]] and [[White dye|white dyes]].
* [[One Small Favour]] — [[Aggie]] asks for helping finding her apprentice, [[Jimmy the Chisel]].
* [[Prince Ali Rescue]] — [[Prince Ali]] is held in the [[Draynor jail|village jail]].
* [[Rag and Bone Man I]] — [[Fortunato]] sells the [[vinegar]] needed to clean the bones.
* [[Swan Song]] — The [[Wise Old Man]] plays a large role in the quest.
* [[Vampyre Slayer]] — Started by speaking to [[Morgan]].
* [[Ernest the Chicken]] — Started by speaking to [[Veronica]].
